# `gcp.cloudresourcemanager.capabilityconfig`

Capability configs define the enabled capabilities and their scope of enforcement for folders, organizations, or projects within the resource hierarchy.

[cloudresourcemanager](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| Service | cloudresourcemanager |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/CapabilityConfig` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 1200s |
